fixed.problem: Reviewer non-blocking 2, the effort-max sibling of L4-money-303: reviewCallUsdMicro priced every review's floor at 2,048 tokens out. A review at effort max (tier 3, or tier 2 raised by the slider) is never sized down, so its first call asks for at least 8,192. A tier 3 task whose room lay between those two prices started its review, ran its checks and wrote a critic Run row; then its first call was refused.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/task-budget-all.test.ts 'l4-selftasks-check, run L4' > 'L4-money-303 at effort max: a tier 3 task whose left lies above the price at 2,048 tokens out but below its first call's at 8,192: no review starts, no critic Run row, one review-waits card' (failed before: one critic Run row). Also packages/critic/test/review-price.test.ts 'at effort max on Opus 5.5 (a tier 3 review): ... the floor is the same input with 8,192 tokens out' (failed before: 81,252 instead of 204,132).
fixed.how: packages/critic/src/critic.ts reviewCallUsdMicro: least = maxEffort ? out : (maxTokensPerCall ?? REVIEW_MIN_TOKENS_PER_CALL), and the ReviewCallPrice.floorUsdMicro doc now says so. The composed case runs on the Messages API stand-in with the composition's test-only process pin for every tier (world().open({ everyTier }) -> sandboxProcessForEveryTier). It derives the 2,048 and 8,192 prices from the critic's own model (service.modelFor) and price table (pricingFor), and sets the room a quarter of the way between them. The result: no critic call, no critic Run row, the task needs_human with one card 'The work is done; its review waits for room in the budget.'. Docs: docs/maintainers/critic.md and a dated note in ADR 0112's 2026-11-22 amendment.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Not walkable on the bench: tier 3 needs Docker and the bench prices 1 µUSD per token. Live with Docker: give a tier 3 task a budget whose room after its work is below one Opus call at 8,192 tokens out (about USD 0.21 with its evidence). The task pauses before its review with 'The work is done; its review waits for room in the budget.' in the Inbox, with no critic run and no checks under Details. With room above that price, the review runs.

A review whose task budget does not hold it back (left ≥ the session token's budget) is not sized to the room (sizedToRoom needs left < token budget), so its first call still asks for 8,192 tokens out. notes_for_other_areas: CriticService.reviewCallUsdMicro: floorUsdMicro is the first call's whole price at the least output that call asks for. That is REVIEW_TOKENS_PER_CALL (8,192) at effort max (never sized down), else maxTokensPerCall ?? REVIEW_MIN_TOKENS_PER_CALL (2,048). The runner's review start (runner.ts, left < floorUsdMicro) is its only reader.
